parsed.why: No trans-specific criminal ban and orientation discrimination prohibited, but no gender-identity protection, documented 2024 police assault/detention of a trans woman, weak implementation and social stigma; no custody or border data.

New penal code criminalises same-sex conduct with 2-5 years and reaches perceived gender nonconformity; documented post-code arrests and abuse based on appearance, no anti-discrimination, hostile state. Actual enforcement drives severe risk.

Same-sex conduct decriminalised and no trans-specific penalty documented, but no gender-identity protections or recognition, and no violence, border, facility or custody data. Thin record with structural gaps, not documented state targeting.

Strong parent-law protections: gender-identity discrimination ban, hate-crime aggravator, marriage and marker change. But custody holds trans women by legal sex with documented violations, and local stigma and care gaps reduce safety.

No general criminal ban, but police stop and document trans women, 299 detentions in 2025, hostile officials, prison segregation/strip searches and a custody death, draft criminalisation and no gender-identity protections.
